cues.en: So it's extremely popular in data science and machine learning, which is why we're using it in this course.

cues.zh: 很棒的是，在同一份筆記本裡還能顯示影像、撰寫 Markdown 筆記。

cues.en: So it's a really great learning tool and it's a great teaching tool as well, which is why I use it throughout this course.
cues.zh: 它是很棒的學習與教學工具，所以整門課都會使用。

cues.en: And it's also one of the most popular development environments in data science for exploring and analyzing data.
cues.zh: 也是資料科學中，用來探索和分析資料的熱門開發環境之一。

cues.en: And as you learn more and more about the course and the libraries, then you'll see why it's such a popular tool because you get to see everything on a single screen.
